coordinatorSummary: CONSENT at 0 MUST-FIX, 0 SHOULD-FIX and no advisories. Fourteen attacks run, none landed. This entry discharges my own D-133 turn-2 finding, so I checked it harder rather than lighter: every claim in the inserted sentence was traced to D-133's adopted text, the gate count was counted at source, the do-not-unwrite list was rebuilt from scratch, and the edit was simulated against live bytes. Custody is clean — subject 330ff320 at 0444 unmoved, one dispatch and one prompt agreeing, HEAD never left 02ea752, COORD at f9a82491 and file 08 at 7128f62e with a clean tree — and the predecessor's application checks out, D-141 having changed exactly one file-08 row to the bytes both reviewers consented to. The insertion is safe in the way that matters for a hard-wrapped file: the quoted junction occurs exactly once in all of COORD, as raw unnormalised bytes on one physical line, inside D-056. Simulating the edit reproduces the subject's own stated junction and moves exactly 206 bytes, the inserted sentence plus one separating space, so the two name-list sentences and every other D-056 byte are untouched. The text itself is faithful: the 2026-08-14 dating matches both D-133's wording and D-056's own adoption date; 'not the definition of eligibility' uses D-056's own heading term for its gate set; and 'the five gates of the pinned D-056 turn-2 subject' resolves to a file live at dfb0c2af at 0444 whose Eligibility section contains exactly five numbered gates, matching the five stated inline. The sentence is labelled 'Forward pointer (D-133):', so it reads as annotation rather than as text D-056's reviewers consented to, and it adds no gate and removes none — the holding was D-133's, adopted at CONSENT from both reviewers. Reversibility mirrors D-133's with the one addition it needs, D-133 itself, and its do-not-unwrite list is complete: exactly four entries record a row SATISFIED under D-056, D-085, D-089, D-091 and D-092 for DR-102, DR-115, DR-119 and DR-123, and all four are named. Worth recording positively: the COORD-scope gap I raised at D-140 turn 2 and again at D-141 does not recur here — this entry states its footprint in stronger terms than the clause that went missing, calling its insertion the only allowed non-append COORD mutation and only after CONSENT. Three items I looked at and declined are recorded in the verdict so the choices are auditable. With this entry the D-139 H set is exhausted; what remains under D-139 is the L-section leftover-design closures and the W wait edges.
